notes.title: RAT SHOOT NOW ON MAC!
notes.content:
Hey Rat Shooters! 

First of all, HAPPY NEW YEAR!

Great news, as promised, Rat Shoot is now available to download on MAC OS via Steam!

While working on all things apple, we have also been working on an iOS app, which is now available on the Apple App Store! Just search "Rat Shoot".

We would love your feedback and any ideas to improve the game. Reach out via email support@st-dev.net

Have an amazing 2023
- ST DEV

notes.title: Tuning Update
notes.content: Today we have pushed a small tuning update. This update has tuned the levels to make them progress a little faster. More rats will appear quicker than before. This means there is less waiting for the next rat to try and cross the room, and the more rats you kill, the faster they will come at you! This keeps the game fast-paced and keeps your heart going!

notes.title: Rat Shoot Is Now Available
notes.content:
[h1][b]Rat Shoot is now available to play from the Steam Store![/b][/h1]

We hope you enjoy playing Rat Shoot as much as we enjoyed making it!
Should you find a bug, let us know in the discussions.

A mac version is on the way. Stay tuned!

Remember to try and top those leaderboards! Have fun!

[i]ST DEV[/i]

notes.title: Rat Shoot Steam Store Page is now Live!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

It's great to have you! Let us tell you a bit about Rat Shoot. Rat Shoot is a 2D casual action game about stopping rats before they escape. How do you stop them? You shoot them!! It's not as easy as it sounds, as Rats are quick, sneaky and can hide under objects. You will also need to focus on cleaning up the dead rats to enable you to unlock more levels and challenges. Each level and challenge features a leaderboard that you can try and top.
 
The game is finished development and is currently undergoing private beta testing, with a release expected Mid November 2022. The game was originally developed for mobile last year. The Steam version is much more updated with new graphics, new levels, more features and far better gameplay. An updated mobile version is in the pipeline, but first, we want to focus on Windows and Mac.

Rat Shoot will initially be released for Windows only, but a Mac version will follow. The Steam Store launch is an important step for us, as it is not only our first game on Steam, but it gives you an amazing chance to see what the game will entail. Take a look and let us know your comments in the community forums. If you want a private chat with us, you can send us an email support@st-dev.net.

Be sure to wishlist and be the first to know about the release!

Thanks for checking out Rat Shoot, and we will meet again soon!

[i]ST DEV[/i]
